brief_rationale: The trajectory met all serious responsibility-chain duties: the doctor screened and safety-netted for recurrent ischemia/syncope and access-site complications, clarified inpatient/discharge and PCI status, prevented post-stent medication interruption, and converted fragmented records into an executable follow-up plan. No important non-chain defect is present; the doctor consistently preserved uncertainty and deferred clinician-dependent decisions to the treating cardiology team. Multiple high-order points were actively completed, including phase-by-phase timeline reconstruction, verification of ambiguous record/result fragments, privacy/low-intrusion workaround for caregiver information gaps, and dynamic reprioritization when inpatient status and discharge medication execution became known. This supports grade 5.

closure_assessment.explanation: The bounded episode ended after formal discharge medication reconciliation, red-flag escalation thresholds, one-week follow-up planning, and caregiver teach-back. Remaining uncertainties such as residual coronary disease details and EF follow-up were assigned to the PCI/cardiology follow-up with documents and drug bags.
